content:
As the EU's new transparency requirements for AI-generated content take effect, WhatsApp is developing a feature that lets channel admins label certain types of AI-generated content. Here's what you need to know.

"Channel admins in your country/region must label channel updates that use AI content"

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is developing a feature that lets channel admins flag certain types of content as AI-generated.

References to the new feature can be found in the latest WhatsApp Android beta version, but the feature appears to be designed in response to regulatory requirements in specific countries/regions, so the iOS version is expected to launch later, with a broader rollout to follow.

According to the report, the new feature will follow the same workflow channel admins use for sponsored content:

WABetaInfo notes that not all AI-generated content must be labeled. As described in the current launch screen, AI content includes images, video, or other media created or edited using AI tools.

In other words, admins don't appear to need to label AI-generated text. It remains unclear whether this option will roll out globally or only in regions where labeling is legally required.
